title: Phase 55G converts the Project Baccara county vote and air-permit gates
summary: FTFN replaced a reported-vote and proposed-permit stopping point with two official downstream records: Maricopa County's 4-1 Board action summary and MCAQD's signed final Title V Permit P0013417. The repaired signal remains In Review because service, condition compliance, construction, occupancy, and operation are not established.
evidence_note: The County summary establishes the approve motion and 4-1 vote but is not the fully executed MCP. The signed final air permit closes the proposed-permit gate but does not prove that other conditions are satisfied or that the power plant or data center is constructed, occupied, commissioned, or operating.
